title: NuPhy keyboard
setupCli: Manual setup required: install nuphyctl with `omarchy pkg aur add nuphyctl-bin`, then restart the Omarchy shell. The plugin does not install this dependency automatically.
setupHid: Manual setup required: your account cannot access the keyboard's HID interface. Install or update nuphyctl-bin for its udev rule, then reconnect the keyboard in an active local desktop session. Do not run the shell as root.
help: Select a zone, edit its lighting, then Apply. Theme sync keeps the selected effect and brightness. Settings shown are saved preferences, not readings from the keyboard.
keymapSearch: Search keys, media, modifiers, or functions…
keymapRefreshNeeded: Refresh to read the connected keyboard. Pending edits remain available after a disconnect.
keymapHelp: Edits stay pending across layers and popup closes. Apply writes all pending changes. Resolve every conflict before applying. • marks a pending edit; * marks an assignment changed from factory.
keymapApplied: Changes applied and read back successfully.
keymapUnchanged: The keyboard already matches these assignments.
keymapDetached: A draft from a previous connection is retained. Review the target keyboard and pending edits before attaching it. Incompatible layouts require discarding the draft.
keymapConflict: Conflict: keyboard now has %1. Choose which assignment to keep.
keymapMatrixHelp: Matrix view — cells follow firmware rows and columns, which may differ from physical key positions. Scroll sideways to see all columns.
keymapRequestLayout: Request or correct a keyboard layout ↗
keymapRequestLayoutHelp: Open a GitHub issue draft with the model, firmware and geometry. Add a photo or NuPhyIO screenshot before submitting.
keymapLayoutLinkError: Could not open the browser. Report the layout at github.com/fldc/omarchy-nuphy/issues.
settingsRefreshHelp: Read the keyboard again and discard pending settings edits.
settingsUnavailable: Refresh to read settings. A compatible nuphyctl backend and mechanical keyboard are required; HE settings are unsupported.
settingsApplied: Settings applied and read back successfully.
settingsUnchanged: The keyboard already matches these settings.
autoSleepHelp: Disabling auto sleep preserves both timers.
level2Sleep: Level 2 Sleep · lights and communication off
sleepOrder: Timers range from 5–127 minutes. Level 2 follows Level 1.
accessoryHelp: Read this only on a keyboard with a swappable knob/button. Other models may not support the accessory switch.
settingsHelp: Edits stay pending until Apply. Only edited fields are written; failures refresh hardware state and are never retried automatically.
